# Metro Optics

> Eyewear storefront for eyeglasses, sunglasses and everyday frames.

Use the linked pages as the source of truth. Product prices, colors, sizes and availability can change; rely on the current product page rather than copied summaries.
For prescription or clinical vision questions, consult a qualified eye-care professional.

## Public pages
- [Frequently asked questions](https://metro-optics.vercel.app/faq): Answers about ordering, lens options, delivery, returns and support.
- [Contact Metro Optics](https://metro-optics.vercel.app/contact): Current contact details and support options.
- [About Metro Optics](https://metro-optics.vercel.app/about): The store's approach to eyewear and customer guidance.
